platform: Claude Code WebSearch tool, US region
query_verbatim: Pine Script "ta.pivothigh" definition "leftbars" "rightbars" returns price of the pivot high point
extracted_verbatim: ta.pivothigh(source, leftbars, rightbars) returns the price of a pivot high point, or NaN if there was no pivot high point. leftbars: how many bars to the left of a potential pivot are considered, and the current bar needs to be higher than these to qualify as a pivot high. rightbars: the number of bars to the right, and the current bar should be higher than these bars for it to be a pivot high. A pivot is confirmed only after rightbars complete.
